test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Courtyard**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Courtyard**: An area of flat ground outside and partly or completely surrounded by one or more buildings. (एक या एक से अधिक इमारतों से आंशिक रूप से या पूरी तरह से बाहर समतल जमीन का एक क्षेत्र)
 
• **Churchyard**: An enclosed area surrounding a church, especially as used for burials. (एक चर्च के आसपास का एक संलग्न क्षेत्र, विशेष रूप से दफनाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है)
 
• **Shipyard**: An enclosed area of land where ships are built and repaired. (भूमि का एक संलग्न क्षेत्र जहाँ जहाजों का निर्माण और मरम्मत की जाती है)
 
• **Junkyard**: A place where scrap is collected before being recycled or discarded. (एक जगह जहां पुनर्नवीनीकरण या त्यागने से पहले स्क्रैप एकत्र किया जाता है)
 
 
 
• In this passage, It is said that the area is used for dances and ceremonial festivals, the most significant of which is conducted on the night of Buddha Purnima.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**courtyard**" is the most appropriate option.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *The monastery in Tawang has recently undergone (1) renovation__ and bright paintings __(2) adorn__ its walls. Dances and ceremonial celebrations are held in the **__(3) courtyard__**, the most important of which is held on the night of Buddha Purnima, the full moon on which the Buddha was born, (4)_________ enlightenment and died. To reach Tawang, you drive for 12 hours from Assam’s Tezpur town, a major Indian Forces base. The best season the visitor can choose for coming to Tawang is (5)_________ September **and** November.*

1c1:T11f1,

The correct answer is: **Attained**
